'''Corporate offices''' in [[Benoga]], a [[City/Legends|city]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vulpter/Legends|Vulpter]], served as the company headquarters of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. When the Trade Federation relocated its headquarters offworld and closed its Benoga [[Factory/Legends|manufacturing plants]], the city quickly fell into disrepair and was deserted within a few [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="Vulpter" />
